title: gh-labeler label config
description: Declarative GitHub label configuration for gh-labeler. Either a bare array of labels or an object with a `labels` array and options.

prune.description: Delete repository labels that are not declared in `labels`. Default: false. Never inherited through `extends`.

extends.description: Base config(s) to inherit labels from. Each entry is a path starting with './', '../', or '/' (relative to this file) or 'owner/repo[:path]' for another repository. Bases merge in order; this file's labels override inherited ones by name (case-insensitive).

name.description: Label name as shown on GitHub.

color.description: 6-digit hex color with '#' prefix, e.g. '#d73a4a'. 3-digit shorthand is not supported. Required unless `delete` is true.

description.description: Label description shown on GitHub. GitHub caps this at 100 characters.

aliases.description: Old names for this label. An existing label matching an alias is renamed instead of deleted and recreated.

delete.description: When true, delete this label from the repository if it exists. Such an entry needs only `name`.
